name: American Red CrossHQ
mission: Since its founding in 1881 by visionary leader Clara Barton, the American Red Cross has been the nation's premier emergency response organization. We bring shelter, food and comfort to those affected by disasters, large and small. We collect lifesaving donated blood and supply it to patients in need. We provide support to our men and women in military bases around the world, and to the families they leave behind. We train communities in CPR, first aid and other skills that save lives. And we assist our neighbors abroad with critical disaster response, preparedness and disease prevention efforts. We are able to do all this by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.

dimension_explanations.alignment: This organization is a major provider of humanitarian aid, which is a high-priority cause for many donors [3]. It has a long track record of service and is considered sadaqah-eligible for those making general charitable donations [7]. While it claims to work in five geographic areas, its financial filings do not show specific foreign grants on Schedule F [2].
dimension_explanations.impact: The charity is efficient with its spending, directing a Program expense ratio of 90.8% toward its services in FY2024 [2]. It maintains 12.2 months of working capital, which provides a stable financial cushion for emergencies [1]. However, the cost to help each person is high at $5,730.14, and the organization lacks a formal theory of change to track long-term results [6].

strengths_deep_dive: The American Red Cross demonstrates strong financial stewardship, allocating <cite id="1">90.8% of expenses to programs in FY2024</cite>. This performance beats the 75% industry benchmark and matches the peer median of 90.0%. Independent evaluators recognize this fiscal health, awarding the organization an <cite id="1">overall rating of 93.0/100 on Charity Navigator</cite> alongside full accreditation from the BBB Wise Giving Alliance [1]. Operationally, the charity tracks concrete metrics, having installed <cite id="6">2,600,000 smoke alarms</cite> through safety campaigns [6].
rich_narrative.summary: The American Red Cross works to prevent and alleviate human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing volunteers and donors [3]. Operating as a major relief entity, the organization reported <cite id="2">$3,217,077,611 in revenue in FY2024</cite> with multi-year revenue expansion showing a <cite id="2">3-year CAGR of 9.3%</cite>. Its activities include disaster relief, blood services, support for military families, and lifesaving training [6]. In FY2024, the charity maintained a <cite id="1">90.8% program expense ratio</cite>, directing the overwhelming majority of its spending to direct operations. However, high delivery costs average <cite id="2">$5,730.14 per beneficiary</cite>, reflecting intensive domestic emergency response infrastructure. Donors looking for large-scale domestic emergency infrastructure can support its mission through general sadaqah [7].
